# Test Fixtures

These `.riv` files are sourced from [rive-app/rive-runtime](https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime) (MIT License)
and are used for validation testing of the Go parser.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ball_test.riv` | Basic artboard + shape round-trip |
| `artboard_width_test.riv` | Artboard dimension parsing |
| `cubic_value_test.riv` | Cubic curve keyframe values |
| `blend_test.riv` | State machine blend animation |
| `click_event.riv` | Event triggering |

Source path: `tests/unit_tests/assets/` in the rive-runtime repo.
